$comment: WHY A PHOTOGRAPH EXISTS, declared before one is acquired. A purpose names the surface the picture is FOR, the register key it fills, the page it is published on, and the minimum a photograph must be to do that job. scripts/images/acquire.py refuses a purpose that is not here and refuses a photograph that does not meet its requirements; tools/lib/data.py refuses a register row whose purpose is unknown, and refuses two rows claiming the same one. A photograph acquired for the homepage hero must not drift onto a destination page because it happened to be in the register — the surfaces have different jobs, different aspect ratios and different type over them.
$requirements: min_width is native pixels, not the ladder's widest step: a 1,200px original upscaled to 2,400 is the same untruth as a population we estimated, and derive.py already refuses to upscale. orientation and aspect are the mechanical half of whether a picture can do the job; the editorial half — subject placement, hierarchy, whether it looks like generic stock — is why discovery presents candidates to a person instead of picking one. AND /plan HAS NO HERO SLOT ON PURPOSE. A purpose was declared for it and removed in the same session: the planner is an instrument, its title is a label rather than a headline because the page IS the tool, and that came from a measurement — the magazine head pushed the control to y=436 and half the first screen of a tool was a headline and four lines of prose. A photograph above the sentence box would undo exactly that, so the honest answer is no slot rather than a slot nobody should fill.

homepage-hero.surface: The full-bleed opening of the homepage, with the masthead over it and the headline beside it.
homepage-hero.note: docs/hero-brief.md holds the editorial brief. The plate system was MEASURED as unable to carry this surface, which is the whole argument for licensing a photograph at all — so a photograph that reads as generic stock fails the brief even when it passes every number here.

vienna-destination.surface: The opening image of the Vienna destination page.
vienna-destination.note: Vienna's physical identity is the Danube and the historic centre rather than relief — its ground reads 332 m of spread and a 480 m crest, which is why it draws no terrain bands.

chamonix-destination.surface: The opening image of the Chamonix destination page.
chamonix-destination.note: The ground within 40 km spreads 1,798 m and crests at 2,752 m. A photograph here has to carry the valley floor against the wall above it, which is the reading the Stay layer makes in words.

door-mountains.surface: The Mountains door on the homepage — a large editorial card under “Find your Europe”.
door-mountains.note: An alpine morning above cloud — a valley floor against the wall over it, not a summit portrait. These four sit side by side, so a set that reads as four photographs from one stock search fails the brief even when each one passes on its own.

door-coast.surface: The Coast & islands door on the homepage — a large editorial card under “Find your Europe”.
door-coast.note: Where land ends. A cliff, a harbour or an island shore with the sea doing the work. These four sit side by side, so a set that reads as four photographs from one stock search fails the brief even when each one passes on its own.

door-history.surface: The Historic cities door on the homepage — a large editorial card under “Find your Europe”.
door-history.note: A lived-in old street, not a monument. Somebody's Tuesday in a two-thousand-year-old city. These four sit side by side, so a set that reads as four photographs from one stock search fails the brief even when each one passes on its own.

door-food.surface: The Food & wine door on the homepage — a large editorial card under “Find your Europe”.
door-food.note: A table, a market or a vineyard that could only be where it is. Never a styled plate on a board. These four sit side by side, so a set that reads as four photographs from one stock search fails the brief even when each one passes on its own.

journeys-hero.surface: The opening of the journeys index — a wide editorial image beside the headline.
journeys-hero.note: A road, a rail line or a pass with distance in it: the feeling of crossing a border on purpose. Never a map, and never a single landmark. These five open five different indexes and are seen in sequence by anyone using the menu bar, so a set that reads as one stock search fails even when each passes alone.

experiences-hero.surface: The opening of the experiences index.
experiences-hero.note: Somebody DOING the thing — hands, a workshop, a kitchen, a boat. A person at work in a real place, not a posed portrait and not an empty interior. These five open five different indexes and are seen in sequence by anyone using the menu bar, so a set that reads as one stock search fails even when each passes alone.

stories-hero.surface: The opening of the stories index.
stories-hero.note: A human moment that could be the opening frame of a long read. Faces are welcome; a landmark is not. These five open five different indexes and are seen in sequence by anyone using the menu bar, so a set that reads as one stock search fails even when each passes alone.

events-hero.surface: The opening of the events index.
events-hero.note: A European gathering in progress — a procession, a market, a festival crowd at dusk. It must read as a fixture in a real town, not a stadium. These five open five different indexes and are seen in sequence by anyone using the menu bar, so a set that reads as one stock search fails even when each passes alone.
